text.description_html:
Acorn PRAYP, Hand Painted Green Leaf Ceramic Knob

Acorn Manufacturing has a way of brining the feel of nature inside with its hand painted cabinet knobs. The Green Leaf Ceramic Cabinet Knob catches the spirit of the outdoors through color. It has a 1-1/4" diameter. This knob is great for any light weight door like accordion closet doors, hutch drawers, and interior window shutters.

Features of the Green Leaf Ceramic Cabinet Knob:

  • Diameter: 1-1/4"
  • Material: ceramic
  • Each design is hand painted on ceramic.
  • Package includes 1 knob and hardware for installation.

Sold Individually. Due to the hand painted nature of this product, the colors will vary slightly.
